Set a timeout on every outbound HTTP call.
A call with no timeout can wait as long as the other service takes.
When an external API stalls, missing timeouts can exhaust all worker threads and stop the service.
The Python requests library has no default timeout.
Passing a timeout tuple like (connect_timeout, read_timeout) bounds wait times.
